title: V3 stage-oriented refactor CP03 — P5 package-local build baseline and output relocation
goal: Build the trusted Stage Gate and Architecture Conformance projects only from the V3 package-local build and security baseline with a pinned SDK, a single package source, explicit baseline import, disabled directory discovery, enforced lock integrity and an import allowlist, keep build output out of docs/guards, and prove V3 runs from an isolated copy.
acceptanceCriteria: Guard builds run through docs/guards/V3/build/GuardBuild.psm1 with build/global.json, build/NuGet.config, explicit V3.Build.props, all Directory.* discovery disabled and output under artifacts/build.

Restore fails when a reviewed lock file is missing, changes during restore, or disagrees with project.assets.json or the package content hash, and reviewed IFX locks exist for GuardV3.Tests, LayerGuard and LayerGuard.Tests.
Pre-build and post-build import checks allow only the .NET root, V3.Build.props, restore-generated nuget.g files and locked packages, and the IFX import reports pass with zero violations.
Test-V3BuildBaseline passes from an isolated copy surrounded by hostile host configuration and runs in v3-cross-platform on Linux and Windows.
No bin or obj directory is written under docs/guards, all existing guard tests pass, and the 13 required check names are unchanged.
